about: Runs that must NOT end in PASS. check.sh runs each on the wasm named by `wasm` (a build of reference/); `exit` is the exit status certify.sh must return and `reason_contains` a text the certificate's reasons must contain.

guards.name: no-supply
guards.why: nothing can be transferred, so every transfer check would be empty

guards.name: wrong-init
guards.why: the token cannot be set up

guards.name: untracked-holder
guards.why: the supply sits on an account nobody watches

guards.name: too-few-traces
guards.why: one trace does not reach every kind of step, so some monitors have nothing to judge

guards.name: unknown-key
guards.why: a misspelled config key is refused before anything runs; no certificate is written

guards.name: factory-init-by-stranger
guards.reason_contains: Only the factory account can init this contract
guards.why: a factory-only init sent by another account fails; the certificate quotes the token's own message

guards.name: nothing-minted
guards.why: the init succeeds but no tokens exist until a setup call mints them

guards.name: transfer-call-disabled
guards.reason_contains: no ft_transfer_call was accepted in any trace
guards.why: a full run on a token that rejects every ft_transfer_call: no monitor fires, and the settlement monitors made no check
